fields.states[].model: raw: device model as a number in sleep responses
fields.states[].model_id: raw: keeps only the states of the summary's device
fields.states[].state: raw: selects the sleep stage (0 awake, 1 light, 2 deep, 3 rem, 4 manual and 5 unspecified asleep_unspecified, 15 out_of_bed)
fields.summary.data.durationtowakeup: raw: time from waking to getting up, no catalogue code
fields.summary.data.hr_max: raw: nightly heart-rate summary; derivable from stored samples
fields.summary.data.hr_min: raw: nightly minimum, not resting heart rate
fields.summary.data.nb_rem_episodes: raw: count derivable from the stages
fields.summary.data.night_events: raw: event timestamps by type, no catalogue event
fields.summary.data.out_of_bed_count: raw: count derivable from the out_of_bed stages
fields.summary.data.rr_max: raw: nightly respiratory summary, no catalogue code
fields.summary.data.rr_min: raw: nightly respiratory summary, no catalogue code
fields.summary.data.sleep_efficiency: raw: ratio; sleep_efficiency is derived from the session
fields.summary.data.wakeup_latency: raw: time from waking to getting up, no catalogue code
fields.summary.data.waso: raw: sleep_waso is derived from the session's stages
fields.summary.date: raw: the night's date, sets the local day of the daily values
fields.summary.id: raw: identifier (external id of the night)
fields.summary.model: raw: device model as a number in sleep responses
fields.summary.model_id: raw: device type derived from the model id
fields.summary.timezone: raw: IANA zone of the night
